growth_duration_source: DA-Cagayan Valley corn techno-guide 2018 lists 92-101 days for common hybrids; FAO-56 Table 11 gives 125-180 days across tropical and arid regions; Purdue NCH-40 classes: early 85-100; mid 101-130; full 131-145 days
water_requirements_by_stage: Optimum 400-600 mm rainfall distributed through the season (DA-CV); critical moisture demand at tasseling-silking and grainfill (DA-CV and Purdue); Kc: ini 0.3; mid 1.20; end 0.60-0.35 (FAO-56 Table 12)
temperature_range_c: Base temperature 10 C; optimal seasonal mean 20-22 C; daytime 25-33 C; night 17-23 C (Purdue)
heat_sensitivity: Stress when air exceeds 32 C during tasseling and silking; each day at 35 C or more during that period reduces dryland yield (Purdue)
preferred_soil_texture: Well-drained silt-loam to loam; poorly drained or heavy soils are unsuitable (DA-CV); loose aerated soil preferred (Wikifarmer)
nutrient_requirements_npk: Soil-test based recommendation (DA-CV Table 2): N about 60-120 kg/ha; P2O5 0-60 kg/ha; K2O 0-60 kg/ha depending on soil status; corn is a heavy nitrogen feeder
root_characteristics: Fibrous root system; maximum effective rooting depth 1.0-1.7 m (FAO-56 Table 22)
waterlogging_sensitivity: Sensitive; flooding kills young plants and excessive water is detrimental (DA-CV)
source_title: DA-Cagayan Valley Corn Production Techno-Guide; FAO Irrigation and Drainage Paper 56; Purdue NCH-40; Wikifarmer maize soil article
units_notes: duration in days; temperature in degrees Celsius; water in mm; pH dimensionless; nutrients in kg per ha; root depth in m; depletion fraction p dimensionless
uncertainty_notes: Maturity depends strongly on hybrid and climate; NPK figures are soil-test dependent ranges; rainfall totals are regional guidance not field measurements FAO-56 Table 22 maize (field grain) p=0.55 for ETc about 5 mm/day; adjust p = p_table + 0.04(5 - ETc), bounded 0.1-0.8.

growth_duration_source: Philippine DA mungbean guide: harvest 60-70 days after planting; FAO-56 Table 11 green gram: 110 days total for March planting in the Mediterranean
water_requirements_by_stage: Relatively drought tolerant; sufficient water needed at critical stages (germination; vegetative; flowering and podding) (DA); Kc: ini 0.4; mid 1.05; end 0.60-0.35 (FAO-56 Table 12)
heat_sensitivity: Continuous rain and high humidity reduce seed quality (DA); no specific heat ceiling recorded in the source
preferred_soil_texture: Sandy loam; well-drained; adapts to different soil types (DA)
nutrient_requirements_npk: N supplied mainly by rhizobial fixation; avoid excess nitrogen; 30-45 kg P/ha and 30-45 kg K/ha in deficient soils; without soil test basal 14-14-14 at 150 kg/ha on heavy soils and 200 kg/ha on light soils; if seeds are inoculated apply 20 kg N/ha (about 150 kg Triple14) (DA)
root_characteristics: Well-developed taproot with deeply placed lateral roots; maximum effective rooting depth 0.6-1.0 m (FAO-56 Table 22)
nitrogen_fixation_conditions: Symbiosis with N-fixing rhizobia in root nodules; seed inoculation with the right strain recommended; excessive nitrate fertilizer restricts fixation (DA)
waterlogging_sensitivity: Sensitive to extended waterlogging; heavy soils are suitable only for dry-season planting (DA)
source_title: Philippine Department of Agriculture HVCDP Mungbean Production Guide; FAO Irrigation and Drainage Paper 56
units_notes: duration in days; temperature in degrees Celsius; water in mm; pH dimensionless; nutrients in kg per ha; root depth in m; depletion fraction p dimensionless
uncertainty_notes: Harvest window reflects short-duration tropical types; FAO-56 green gram cycle is longer under cooler conditions FAO-56 Table 22 green gram and cowpeas p=0.45.

growth_duration_source: FAO-56 Table 11 groundnut: 130 days (West Africa dry season) to 140 days (other regions)
water_requirements_by_stage: Rainfall during the growing period by maturity class: extremely early 250-400 mm; early 300-500 mm; late 500-1000 mm; above 1000 mm plant on ridges unless the soil is very well drained (ICRISAT ASHC); Kc: mid 1.15; end 0.60 (FAO-56 Table 12)
temperature_range_c: Optimum 25-30 C; below 17 C growth almost ceases (ICRISAT ASHC)
heat_sensitivity: Temperatures above 35 C are detrimental to production (ICRISAT ASHC)
soil_ph_range: 5.5-7.0 slightly acidic to neutral; saline soils are not tolerated (ICRISAT ASHC)
preferred_soil_texture: Deep; loose; well-drained sandy; sandy loam or loamy sand without compaction layers (ICRISAT ASHC)
nutrient_requirements_npk: Legume with biological N fixation so N needs are low; apply phosphorus fertilizer such as SSP or TSP before planting; potassium according to soil test; rates depend on soil analysis (ICRISAT ASHC)
root_characteristics: Maximum effective rooting depth 0.5-1.0 m (FAO-56 Table 22)
nitrogen_fixation_conditions: Fixes atmospheric N; residual N benefits the following cereal crop in rotation (ICRISAT ASHC)
waterlogging_sensitivity: Cannot tolerate waterlogging; use raised beds or ridges (ICRISAT ASHC)
source_title: ICRISAT/CABI Africa Soil Health Consortium Groundnut Cropping Guide Version 04; FAO Irrigation and Drainage Paper 56
units_notes: duration in days; temperature in degrees Celsius; water in mm; pH dimensionless; nutrients in kg per ha; root depth in m; depletion fraction p dimensionless
uncertainty_notes: Water requirement varies strongly with maturity class; the guide does not give a single seasonal total FAO-56 Table 22 groundnut p=0.50.

growth_duration_source: FAO-56 Table 11: 125 days tropical rainy season and 150 days Mediterranean; Wikifarmer notes 4-5 months of warm temperatures are needed
water_requirements_by_stage: Moderate; keep soil moist at establishment and storage-root initiation; avoid excess moisture and waterlogged conditions (UMD Extension; Wikifarmer); Kc: mid 1.15; end 0.65 (FAO-56 Table 12)
temperature_range_c: Optimal growth 21-29 C; plants tolerate 18-35 C; frost-sensitive; minimum soil temperature for sprouting about 16 C (UMD Extension)
heat_sensitivity: Very sensitive to frost and cold; heat is not the limiting factor (UMD Extension; Wikifarmer)
preferred_soil_texture: Well-drained sandy to sandy loam; avoid heavy soils and high water tables (UMD Extension; Wikifarmer)
nutrient_requirements_npk: Starter fertilizer such as 15-30-15 or 8-8-8; nitrogen about 50-75 lb per acre (roughly 56-84 kg/ha) depending on soil phosphorus and potassium status; avoid excess nitrogen which favours vines over storage roots (UMD Extension)
root_characteristics: Storage roots are enlarged lateral roots and not tubers; maximum effective rooting depth 1.0-1.5 m (FAO-56 Table 22)
waterlogging_sensitivity: Sensitive; avoid soils that stand water for more than 24 hours (UMD Extension)
source_title: University of Maryland Extension Sweet Potatoes publication; FAO Irrigation and Drainage Paper 56; CIP Sweetpotato Facts and Figures; Wikifarmer sweet potato soil article
units_notes: duration in days; temperature in degrees Celsius; water in mm; pH dimensionless; nutrients in kg per ha; root depth in m; depletion fraction p dimensionless
uncertainty_notes: Seasonal water total not stated in the sources; nutrient rates are US extension ranges and should be recalibrated locally FAO-56 Table 22 sweet potato p=0.65.

growth_duration_source: FAO-56 Table 11 cassava year 1 total 210 days (tropical rainy season); Philippine practice harvests at 6-12 months depending on variety and intended use
water_requirements_by_stage: Adequate moisture is essential during the first 3 months for root and shoot growth and tuber formation; often grown rainfed where rainfall is adequate; tolerates drought but yields decline (CARDI); Kc year 1: ini 0.3; mid 0.80; end 0.30; year 2: mid 1.10; end 0.50 (FAO-56 Table 12)
temperature_range_c: Best between 25 and 30 C (DA guide summarized by Juan Magsasaka); tropical and subtropical crop
heat_sensitivity: No documented heat ceiling; cold and frost limit production
soil_ph_range: Wide range; ideal 5.5-7.5 (CARDI); 5.5-6.5 ideal and tolerates acidic aluminium-rich soils (DA guide summarized by Juan Magsasaka)
preferred_soil_texture: Loose friable sandy loam to clay loam; good drainage is essential (CARDI; Juan Magsasaka)
nutrient_requirements_npk: Nutrient removal at 20 t fresh roots per ha: 54 kg N; 11 kg P2O5; 76 kg K2O; general recommendation 400 kg 14-14-14 per ha; at least 30 percent of nutrient needs from organic sources (Juan Magsasaka after DA-NOMIARC)
root_characteristics: Tuberous storage roots; maximum effective rooting depth 0.5-0.8 m in year 1 and 0.7-1.0 m in year 2 (FAO-56 Table 22)
waterlogging_sensitivity: Cannot tolerate waterlogging beyond about 24 hours; prolonged saturation causes root rot (Juan Magsasaka)
source_title: CARDI Fact Sheet No. 04 Growing Cassava - Soil and Water Management; Juan Magsasaka Cassava Farming guide (after DA-NOMIARC); FAO Irrigation and Drainage Paper 56
units_notes: duration in days; temperature in degrees Celsius; water in mm; pH dimensionless; nutrients in kg per ha; root depth in m; depletion fraction p dimensionless
uncertainty_notes: Harvest age varies by variety and market use; nutrient removal scales with yield; temperature range comes from secondary national guidance FAO-56 Table 22 cassava year 1 p=0.35; year 2 p=0.40. The single value uses year 1; state the year in the evaluation.
